Then OR2 (target-0) on p and q forces that at least one of them is true, which holds exactly when x, y, z are not all equal (since p=0 if x=y and q=0 if y=z). Thus the constraints are satisfiable iff the output triple satisfies NAE3.

Introduce complementary variables x', y', z' forced to be the negations of x, y, z via pairs of NAE-5 constraints with constant false and true.
